subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: Shabab said to Tahsin, "Did you visit the Shat Gombuj Mosque?" "No, I didn't", said Tahsin. "I was there last week. How beautiful the mosque is!" said Shabab. "Let's go there next year." Tahsin said.
guide_solution: Shabab asked Tahsin whether he (T) had visited the Shat Gambuj Mosque. Tahsin replied in the negative and said that he (T) had not visited it. Shabab said that he (S) had been there the previous week and exclaimed with joy that the mosque was very beautiful. At this Tashin proposed to Shabab that they should go there the following year.
